skills.name: bug-repro

skills.name: changelog-writer
skills.description: Turn a range of commits or merged PRs into a user-facing changelog entry grouped by Added, Changed, Fixed, and Removed.

skills.name: commit-message
skills.description: Write a clear git commit message (subject + body) from a staged diff, explaining what changed and why.

skills.name: security-review

skills.name: test-plan-writer
